title: GridShell /host + /mcp request envelope
description: Sent by an MCP client on /mcp; forwarded verbatim by server.py to the matching /host client (see README.md for how the session id routes it there). server.py never inspects `tool`/`params` - this envelope is tool-agnostic by design.

id.description: Caller-generated correlation id, unique per in-flight call. Echoed back verbatim on the matching response envelope.

tool.description: Tool name (e.g. "runBatch", "getValues") - a literal name, resolved app-side; server.py does not interpret it.

params.description: Tool-specific arguments, as a plain object. Defaults to {} if omitted.

timeoutMs.description: How long server.py should wait for the /host client's response before giving up. Omitted or non-positive falls back to a 15000ms server-side default.
